name: smwsprites-invisible-sprite
title: Invisible Sprite
description:
This is basically the invisible mushroom sprite, only it, well, isn't limited to a mushroom. You can make it spawn a normal or custom sprite, or even five sprites at once. Based off of Sonikku's invisible mushroom disassembly, although this one has about 3-4 times more code than the original did.

Now SA-1 hybrid.
